issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш дорогой шеф, за чужой счёт пьют даже трезвенники и язвенники.
issues.translation_quote: on someone else's dime even the abstemious drink and the ulcerous!
issues.justification: The pairing 'трезвенники и язвенники' is a humorous rhyming/aphoristic formula; 'the abstemious ... the ulcerous' is stilted and loses the comic punch and register of the boss's maxim.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a stack of tickets and you'll win... A water tower!
issues.justification: The rhymed lottery slogan (пачку/водокачку) is a joke and loses its rhyme; 'water tower' is also not 'водокачка' (water pump house). The comic rhyming jingle is lost.

issues.source_quote: Ну-ка иди отсюда, Миша! Как у вас там говорят, топай до хазы.
issues.translation_quote: As your lot say, beat it to your crib.
issues.justification: 'Crib' is anachronistic American slang that clashes with the Soviet-era setting; the criminal-jargon joke ('хаза') is lost and the register is jarring.

issues.source_quote: Я встретил Вас и всё былое В отжившем сердце ожило...
issues.translation_quote: I met you, and all the past Came alive in my worn-out heart...
issues.justification: Rendered adequately in content, but 'в отжившем сердце' (outlived/spent heart) as 'worn-out' loses the romance register; minor. More importantly the interrupted structure of the romance with the dialogue is fine.

issues.source_quote: Ксива? Паспорт... готов! Хаза? Отель «Атлантик». Двухкоечный нумер...
issues.translation_quote: Papers? Passport... ready! Crib? Hotel "Atlantic". Twin-bed rhoom... paid for!
issues.justification: Criminal slang 'ксива/хаза' is rendered with anachronistic 'crib'; 'Papers? Passport' also fails to reflect the slang-vs-plain pairing. 'Atlantic' later becomes 'Atlantica', an inconsistency of the hotel's name.

issues.source_quote: Строго на север, порядка... 50-ти метров, расположен туалэт, типа сортир, обозначенный на схеме буквами «Мэ» и «Жо».
issues.translation_quote: marked on the diagram with the letters "M" and "W"
issues.justification: Letters 'М' and 'Ж' (men/women) are a Russian convention and the joke (Мэ/Жо) is lost; 'M' and 'W' do not convey the comic pronunciation.

issues.source_quote: около пыхты
issues.translation_quote: the fur tree
issues.justification: 'Пихта' is fir; the translation first uses 'fur tree' and later 'fir tree', creating an inconsistency and a likely mistranslation.

issues.source_quote: Дитям - мороженое, его бабе - цветы. Смотри, не перепутай!
issues.translation_quote: ice cream fer the kiddies, flowers fer his old lady. Mind ya don't mix 'em up!
issues.justification: The punchline is that Lyolik mixes them up (ice cream thrown at the face/flowers); acceptable, but the dialect spelling ('fer', 'ya') introduces an unmotivated register for this character.

issues.source_quote: Куй железо, не отходя от кассы!
issues.translation_quote: strike while the iron's hot — before you leave the till!
issues.justification: The deliberately garbled idiom (mix of 'куй железо, пока горячо' and 'не отходя от кассы') is a signature joke; the English version works only partly, and 'before you leave the till' is awkward.

issues.source_quote: Если человек идиот - то это надолго.
issues.translation_quote: if a man is an idiot, it's chronic.
issues.justification: 'Chronic' loses the aphoristic punch of 'надолго' (it's for a long time); the boss's pseudo-wisdom quip is weakened.

issues.source_quote: Летний комбинированный костюм «Универсал-69» Поощрительная премия на межобластном форуме современной одежды
issues.translation_quote: A summer convertible suit, "Universal-69". Honorable mention at the inter-regional forum
issues.justification: 'Convertible suit' is odd; the Soviet-style pompous fashion-show parody is only partly kept. 'Jacket into a windbreaker' is a plausible rendering, but 'Mini-Bikini' lacks the original's comic officialese.

issues.source_quote: Нет, на это я пойтить не могу!
issues.translation_quote: No! I ain't goin' for that!
issues.justification: Lyolik's comic uneducated speech ('пойтить') is rendered as American-sounding dialect, and inconsistent with how his speech is handled elsewhere.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках!
issues.translation_quote: Drop dead! May I see you in your coffin, in white slippers!
issues.justification: The vernacular, Odessa-style non-standard grammar of the curse is flattened into standard English, losing the comic voice.

issues.source_quote: Летять уткы… Летять у... утки... и-и два-а гуся-я...
issues.translation_quote: The duckies are flyin'… The du... duckies are flyin'... a-and two-o gee-eese...
issues.justification: Reference to a Soviet song ('Летят утки'); the translation adds diminutive 'duckies' not in the source, altering tone.

issues.source_quote: Эти кретины уверяли, что он был без сознания... Значит, этот лопух ничего не знает.
issues.translation_quote: So this sucker doesn't know a thing.
issues.justification: Acceptable, but the repeated rendering of 'лопух' as 'sucker' versus 'A sucker...' is fine; no issue beyond minor register.

issues.source_quote: Осторожнас...
issues.translation_quote: Carefool...
issues.justification: Gesha's mock-foreign pun is replaced by a misspelling that doesn't clearly signal the intended joke.

issues.source_quote: Пейте. Пейте, пейте...
issues.translation_quote: Drink. Drink, drink...
issues.justification: Unproblematic; but 'Hey! Gramps, got a light?' for 'Папаша, огоньку не найдётся?' is acceptable.

issues.source_quote: Семён Семёнович, ну что Вы так... Спокойно… Выпейте!
issues.translation_quote: Come now, Semyon Semyonovich... Easy… Drink this!
issues.justification: Fine; the 'Nedelya' magazine reference is left untranslated without explanation, losing the humor of the medical-advice parody.

issues.source_quote: Пьянству - бой!
issues.translation_quote: War on drunkenness!
issues.justification: Acceptable rendering of Soviet slogan but the bureaucratic-moralizing voice of the housing manager is flattened elsewhere ('Elements of the dolce vita').

issues.source_quote: Я слишком много знал...
issues.translation_quote: I knew too much...
issues.justification: Adequate, but 'покойник' joke is retained; no major issue.

issues.source_quote: Козадоев! Казладоев!
issues.translation_quote: Kozadoev! Kozlodoev!
issues.justification: The running gag of Lyolik mangling Kozadoev's name (Козлодоев from 'козёл') is not carried by explicit equivalent; only transliterated, so the insult is invisible to English viewers.

issues.source_quote: Ага, вроде живца, понимаю... сам рыбак!
issues.translation_quote: Aha, like live bait, I get it... I'm a fisherman myself!
issues.justification: The source's joke is that Semyon is bait ('живец') and also a fisherman; the translation 'I'm a fisherman myself' is ambiguous and weaker.

issues.source_quote: Что она ни делают - не идут дела!
issues.translation_quote: Whatever they do, nothing works out!
issues.justification: Song lyrics are translated without rhyme, losing the lyrical, comic effect of the original verse.
